sn34.8:1.4: ca hoti samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca. tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī
sn34.8:1.5: samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca. ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ
sn34.8:1.6: aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca. seyyathāpi bhikkhave
sn34.8:1.7: gavā khīraṃ …pe… pavaro cāti. sāvatthī. cattārome bhikkhave jhāyī. katame cattāro.
sn34.8:1.8: idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī. idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo. idha pana
